title: AIRPLUS 3000 sq ft
text: AIRPLUS 3000 sq ft. If I could rate MINUS ZERO I would.  I see that this model is now "discontinued" - I must have purchased the very last POS they had. GRRRRR.  It doesn't work.  I need it to continuously drain out - and even though I have followed very instruction carefully - it does NOT.  It just keeps filling the drain drawer.  I should have know when I opened the box - the drain tube was crushed in multiple places, rendering much of the tube unusable.  I had to cut it - there was just enough hose left that was un-crushed to run it.  There is a pic of part of the crushed tube and the other is to prove I have it properly "plugged" inside to auto drain.  My tech guy told me it is very likely wrong internally - meaning the setup inside will not allow it to auto drain.  Unfortunately for me, my recycle was picked up and I do not have the packing material.  I trusted it was going to work.  I am attempting to get it picked up- and get a refund.  Stay tuned - I will update my review if new info would be helpful.  In the meantime, I should also not that the seller has NO WAY to contact them if you have a problem - other than a hotmail email address.  Yeah.  So I sent an email but do not expect much.  It's already in the junk pile we have going. DO NOT purchase this brand under any circumstance.  JUNK JUNK JUNK! As I said, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem helpful.

product_metadata.title: Airplus Dehumidifiers for Home 3000 Sq Ft 35 Pint Dehumidifier for Basement or Large Room with Drain Hose
features: 【Up to 3000 Sq Ft】Dehumidifiers can remove up to 35 pints of water every day(under 86°F, 80%RH condition), and set humidity from 40% to 80%. The most comfortable humidity is 45-55%.
【Value】Dehumidifier for basement, in 1500 Sq Ft closed room, the humidity drops from 80% to 50%, no more than one hour. Strong dehumidification ability is worth having.

【Drainage】1. Dehumidifier for bedroom or large room, you can use the water tank to collect(0.74 gallons, 2.8L). It stops automatically when the water tank is full to avoid overflow. 2. Dehumidifier for basement or bathroom, You can use the drain hose to drain water automatically, which saves time and effort. Note: The water outlet of the water tank needs to be blocked at this time(the plug is included).

【Quiet】Dehumidifiers for home is designed with low noise. When the humidity drops to the target value, the dehumidifier automatically enters the mute mode. You won't notice the existence of dehumidifiers.

【Easy to Use】The dehumidifier has four wheels that are easy to move at will. The auto defrosting function can prevent the collected water from freezing. And 24Hr timer, convenient to use as required, efficient and energy-saving. Negative ions can effectively purify the air and make your living space healthier.
【Multipurpose】The "Mode" button has 3 functions (fan, dehumidification, anion). When the humidity exceeds 5% of your set value, the dehumidifier will automatically dehumidify.
【Warranty】CE, ETL, RoHs certification. One year warranty. The smaller the space, the faster the dehumidification. AIRPLUS dehumidifier gives you a comfortable environment.
